openThreads.text: Upcoming Xi–Trump meeting complicates secondary-sanctions action against Chinese banks. Updated Aug 27: Trump coy in the Oval Office — 'Who said I'm not? You don't know if I'm doing it' — but no major Chinese financial institution has been listed. Updated Aug 30: Bessent — 'all options are on the table' on sanctioning Beijing over continued purchases, calling reluctance to confront China 'a completely false narrative'; to Reuters, the blockade has already curbed most Chinese purchases and tanker stockpiles are dwindling — 'Problem solved.' Still no new Chinese-bank designation; Bloomberg: buyers with Tehran ties 'shrugged' and Bank Melli's Gulf branches remain open.

Bessent predicts a 'broad array' of countries follows UAE in cutting trade ties — watch for named countries. Updated Aug 30: pledge formalized — new secondary sanctions roll out weekly, banks first, with a possible full cutoff from the dollar system ('no leakage… You're either with us or you're with the Iranians'); still no countries named.
Iran threatened to halt all oil exports in response to the sanctions campaign.

Tanker strikes in the strait: Khasab is the week's third strike — UKMTO 122-26, an inbound tanker hit by an 'unknown projectile' 12nm north of Khasab, Oman at 20:53 UTC Sat Aug 29, confirmed in a delayed report Sun Aug 30; no casualties or environmental impact. Week's ledger: Ash Shishah (UKMTO 120-26, Monday), a Kuwaiti-connected tanker (Wednesday), Khasab (Saturday) — still no names and no attribution, Iranian claim, or denial on any of the three. IRGC harassment continues (drone overflights, targeted surveillance); watch tow/salvage status and UKMTO follow-ups.

Pakistan mediation round one (Munir's Tehran visit) closed without visible outcome — watch for a second round or an announced next step. Updated Aug 30: Qatar is the visible mediation channel and says efforts are 'intensifying' with no 'tangible result' yet (Morung wrap, Sep 1-dated).

Iran–Oman temporary Hormuz corridor formalization: phased framework (temporary joint navigational corridor + joint mine-clearing) discussed with Qatar's PM Aug 27; Rezaei says a 'designated central channel' opens only if the US first meets Iran's conditions; White House has not engaged (per unfiled headline-only reporting); transit-fee dispute and 30–60-day permanent-scheme negotiation still unresolved — watch for the corridor announcement, US reaction, IMO notification, and corridor usage data. Updated Aug 30 (Aug 29 catch-up): Iran says the understanding with Oman will NOT take effect until the US honors the Islamabad MoU; Gharibabadi: the strait 'remains closed' and transit happens only 'in coordination with Iran' (Iran International via Fox live blog — single-outlet).

Pezeshkian–Putin meeting at SCO Bishkek (Sept 1) incl. a reported $25B nuclear-plants MOU — watch for outcomes. Updated Aug 30: the summit opened with Xi, Putin and Pezeshkian gathering for the first time since the war began (Bloomberg SCO takeaways); outcomes are next-report material.
NBC intel-damage report (≥20 US government sites in 8 countries, 2,000+ projectiles, CIA station Riyadh hit, billions in repairs) — watch for official confirmation/denial or the original NBC filing.

Southern-route friction: Cooper reports mines cleared, international lanes open, 'momentum building' (~1,500 vessels assisted, ~750M barrels protected); no new enforcement incident through Aug 29 — then the mine threat resurfaced: IRGC crews were 'observed preparing to launch rockets with sea mines' into the demined strait, prompting the Aug 30 US strike on two Larak launchers. Updated Aug 30: TankerTrackers counts 6.7M bpd crude crossing the blockade line over the past seven days (between Kpler's low transit counts and traders' ~7–8M bpd); UKMTO says traffic is 'reduced, albeit with a slight increase compared with recent lows' and IRGC harassment continues. Prior items — Iranian warship deterring HAANA from the southern 'Oman corridor', Saudi STS supertankers off Oman, Trump's 'immediately and systematically destroyed' warning to new mine-layers — remain watch items; track enforcement incidents and corridor usage.

Rezaei compiling Iran's formal conditions list for reopening Hormuz: reportedly up to $300B compensation for wartime damages, removal of US sanctions, ~$100B frozen assets released, end to the regional war, lifting of the naval blockade (exact sums single-outlet via Crypto Briefing; wires confirm the list itself) — watch for the formal list, US response, and whether the 'designated central channel' opens.

DOJ reviving maritime prize courts to condemn and sell vessels/cargo seized enforcing the blockade, proceeds to Treasury (Bloomberg via Fox Business; SD Tex US Attorney Reitz) — watch for the first condemnation filings and expected owner legal challenges.

FinCEN's Banque Misr UAE special measure is an NPRM (UAE-branch scope only; Egyptian parent untouched) — watch for finalization and for Egyptian/UAE central-bank and Banque Misr responses to the proposed correspondent-account cutoff. Updated Aug 30: Banque Misr is reviewing the NPRM 'with the utmost seriousness' and will respond within the comment period; the UAE central bank ordered a 'special and urgent examination' with a forensic/in-depth lookback; Treasury: ~$1.8B processed for 103 potential shadow-banking companies Jan 2024–Jun 2026; OFAC separately designated Bank Melli Dubai manager Reza Mohammad.

US–Venezuela oil deal implementation: 17 fields, >65B barrels in associated reserves, 55% effective US output share, 100-year rights, ~$100B promised private investment — watch SPR replenishment purchases, the reported Venezuela OPEC exit, and legal/constitutional challenges (Democrats opposed). Updated Aug 30: Trump (Truth Social): Venezuelan oil will 'fill up' the SPR, 'topping out' to begin 'very shortly' — the reserve stood at 289.7M bbl as of Aug 21 (EIA) vs ~395M at end-Jan 2025.

New US strike campaign underway: NIGHT 01 opened Aug 30 with the Larak Island launchers strike (first acknowledged US strike inside Iran since late July, on IRGC crews readying mine-carrying rockets for the strait); Trump threatened Kharg Island ('going to be blown to smithereens!'; NIOC: conditions 'calm and appropriate'); stage-2 next-day leads show further US strikes Sep 1 — watch the campaign's scope and whether Kharg is hit.

Iran's retaliation round(s) for Larak: IRGC struck two US air bases in Jordan (Iranian media: King Hussein, Al-Azraq) with ballistic missiles and drones Aug 30; Jordan intercepted 8 missiles; IRGC claims 'heavy damage' flatly contradicted by US officials; Azizi: 'Retaliation is coming… JUST RUN!' Sep 1 leads point to attacks widening to Gulf states and more US bases — watch follow-up rounds and US/Jordanian/UAE responses.

UAE front (The Hill, Aug 31-dated — excluded from the Aug 30 report): Fars-reported IRGC claim that Al Minhad air base was struck 'hours after' Jordan, a UAE drone intercept over territorial waters, UAE FM 'dangerous escalation' — verify against UAE/US sources and file in the next day report. Updated Aug 30: verified via AP — the UAE Defense Ministry flatly denies the Iranian army's Al Minhad claim ('false'); the drone intercept over its territorial waters is Aug 31-dated and stays with the next day report.
